metric_scope: U is simulated execution occupancy of CPU and memory tokens; not measured CPU/RSS or fixed stub reservation. R is outage-arrival deadline yield, distinct from structural R_cap.
notes: Latency is conditional on returned responses, capped mean deadline ratio for selection (1 if none); counts and uncapped latency are retained. No training/test seed overlap. Workload scale is historical measured calibration; factors, capacities, network budgets, memory tokens and actual-time error are stipulated simulation inputs.
scope: restricted simulation; fixed preferences choose online score weights offline; not native Tide execution
selection_rule: calibration-only mean reward; tie within 1e-12 prefers closest to equal online weights, then grid order
